name: Merrell Moab 3 Mid Waterproof hiking boots
summary: Mid-height waterproof hiking boots for men, with Beluga selected by the owner. Fit, width and the size-specific ASIN need checking; no size availability is promised.
description: Footwear for an evacuation route has to fit the feet that will wear it. The Moab 3 Mid Waterproof combines a mid-height upper with a waterproof membrane in the documented model. Try it with your intended socks and load before a long walk. A familiar hiking boot is more useful than an untested fit, and waterproof construction does not make it safe to wade through deep or contaminated water.

specs.label: Upper
specs.value: Pig suede leather and breathable mesh

specs.label: Weather construction
specs.value: Waterproof membrane; water can still enter over the collar

specs.label: Outsole
specs.value: Vibram TC5+ in the documented manufacturer model

specs.label: Tongue and protection
specs.value: Bellows tongue, rubber toe and heel protection

pros: Mid-height form and bellows tongue suit ordinary trail use.
The manufacturer provides a specific waterproof model rather than a generic boot description.
cons: Fit and break-in comfort have not been tested by us.
Not certified safety-toe, puncture-resistant or biological protective footwear in this profile.
Beluga selection and the recorded ASIN do not establish availability of other sizes or widths.
useCases: Plan a walking route with footwear already checked for fit.
Ordinary hiking and outdoor kit transport within local conditions.
